data.summary: The independent validation of the FR-001 Card transaction fraud detector confirms its design for detecting fraudulent financial transactions. Key performance indicators show a Gini – test of {{m:run_f7fb6e:gini.test}}, a Gini – out‑of‑time of {{m:run_f7fb6e:gini.oot}}, a KS – out‑of‑time of {{m:run_f7fb6e:ks.oot}}, an AUC – hold‑out of {{m:run_f7fb6e:auc.holdout}}, a Brier score – hold‑out of {{m:run_f7fb6e:brier.holdout}}, a Predicted × observed – hold‑out of {{m:run_f7fb6e:calibration_ratio.holdout}}, an Observed outcome rate – hold‑out of {{m:run_f7fb6e:bad_rate.holdout}}, a Recall at coded threshold of {{m:run_f7fb6e:recall_at.holdout}}, a Precision at coded threshold of {{m:run_f7fb6e:precision_at.holdout}}, an Average precision (PR‑AUC) of {{m:run_f7fb6e:avg_precision.holdout}} and an Alert rate of {{m:run_f7fb6e:alert_rate.holdout}}. The review identified {{m:run_f7fb6e:findings.high}} high‑severity finding, {{m:run_f7fb6e:findings.medium}} medium‑severity finding, for a total of {{m:run_f7fb6e:findings.total}} findings. Parity analysis against the legacy model reports a score maximum absolute difference of {{m:run_f7fb6e:score_max_abs_diff}}, rows compared of {{m:run_f7fb6e:rows_compared}} and a coefficient maximum absolute difference of {{m:run_f7fb6e:coef_max_abs_diff}}. Overall rating is Requires remediation before continued use
